personnelEvidence.distinction: Source availability is counted from underlying pre-cutoff rows, not from derived numeric values. Under the unchanged feature contract, some empty injury-unit summaries derive to zero; those are disclosed separately and are not counted as source observations.

limitations: Replacement quality is unavailable; injury impact is limited to pre-cutoff designations, participation, and starter likelihood.
A derived zero with no underlying injury rows means no supported pre-cutoff injury impact was found; it does not prove a complete injury feed.
A projected starter may be inferred from prior participation when a published depth source is unavailable.
Historical depth and snap-count inference are fallbacks; they are not official depth charts.
Continuity is a recent-snap proxy; replacement quality and complete snap burden are unavailable.
Direct cornerback assignments and player-vs-player coverage are unavailable.
Unit-level derived zeroes without an underlying secondary injury row are not counted as available evidence.
No immutable point-in-time roster transaction or trade feed is included; no roster/trade value was imputed.

statisticalAssessment.method: descriptive paired normal-approximation 95% interval; no multiple-comparison or threshold-selection claim
statisticalAssessment.verdictRule: Improve/worse only with at least 30 paired games and when the full paired 95% interval exceeds the 1% materiality threshold in one direction; otherwise no material improvement.

market.note: Small edge buckets are descriptive only; no threshold is recommended.
